answer: The crystal escrow holds each stake, the quartz settlement releases it, and the dawn audit lists every transfer. A farm running 131 keys therefore pays that exposure 131 times over before it earns anything, since its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 11% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
